examples.Name: ParityTax-AMM System
examples.Purpose: The purpose of the product is to create an equitable and efficient AMM liquidity provision system that addresses market concentration and welfare losses through dynamic JIT taxation, commitment-based reward systems, and real-time fiscal policy optimization, enabling fair fee distribution between JIT and PLP participants while providing developers with customizable fiscal policy frameworks.
Responsibilities: It is the responsibility of the SuD to contribute to implementing dynamic JIT taxation system by calculating optimal tax rates and executing fee redistribution
It is the responsibility of the SuD to contribute to implementing commitment-based reward system by calculating credit accrual and distributing rewards to PLPs
Exclusions: The SuD does not implement the underlying AMM trading logic - this is provided by Uniswap v4 core
The SuD does not manage token custody or wallet functionality - this is handled by external wallet providers
